name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

description:
Google Wallet is the safe, fast, and smart way to access your credit cards, debit cards, transit passes, tickets, digital IDs, and more wherever you are—on the go, online, and across Google.

Breeze through checkout on sites, in apps, or in-store wherever contactless payments or Google Pay (GPay) are accepted. 

Google Wallet keeps what matters to you in one secure place with built-in, industry-leading privacy and security.

Safer than swiping your debit card or credit card

Easily use your loyalty benefits
• Keep loyalty cards and gift cards organized and accessible, so you won’t miss a chance to earn or redeem rewards.

View your receipts in one place
• View receipts from online and in-store transactions right in your digital wallet.

Travel with confidence
• Add your airline boarding pass and get real-time updates, like gate changes and departure times for your flight. 
• Store your transit pass in Google Wallet, and pay your fare with just a tap.

Keep event passes handy
• Add your event, concert, and sports tickets to Wallet for easy access. Just open Wallet and show your ticket when entering the event.
• Google Wallet automatically updates your ticket with the latest event information, so you don’t miss a beat.

Speed through online checkout
• Use the GPay button or autofill in Chrome to quickly access credit cards and debit cards saved to your Google Wallet to make online purchases.

Track your online orders
• Link Google Wallet to Gmail to view the status and expected delivery date for your orders – all in one place. (US only)

Manage your digital IDs
• Get quick, reliable access to digital versions of your driver’s license, student ID, and more.

Security and privacy you can count on
• Google Wallet features industry-leading security built right into your Android phone, including 2-Step Verification, Find My Phone, and remote data erase. 
• You choose the info you share between Google products, so you can better control your digital footprint.

Google Wallet is available on all Android phones (Pie 9.0+), Wear OS and Google Fitbit devices.

name: Microsoft Authenticator
summary: No more passwords, easier sign-in, and greater protection for your accounts.
description:
Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication or passwordless. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work or school accounts.

Getting started with multi-factor authentication

Multi factor authentication (MFA) or two factor authentication (2FA) provides a second layer of security. When logging in with multi-factor authentication, you’ll enter your password, and then you’ll be asked for an additional way to prove it’s really you. Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The one-time passwords (OTP codes) have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The one-time password (OTP) doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.

Getting started with passwordless

Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.

Microsoft personal, work or school accounts

Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain files, emails, or apps. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator also supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each. Because Microsoft Authenticator supports single sign-on, once you have proven your identity once, you will not need to log in again to other Microsoft apps on your device.

Optional Access Permissions

Microsoft Authenticator includes the following optional access permissions. All these require user consent. If you choose to not grant these optional access permissions, you can still use Microsoft Authenticator for other services that do not require such permission. For more information see https://aka.ms/authappfaq

Location: Sometimes your organization wants to know your location before allowing you to access certain resources. The app will request this permission only if your organization has a policy requiring location.

Camera: Used to scan QR codes when you add a work, school, or non-Microsoft account.

Read the contents of your storage: This permission is only used when you report a technical problem through the app settings. Some information from your storage is collected to diagnose the issue.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.

Your goal is to dismantle intricate tile structures by identifying and matching pairs of "free" tiles that aren't blocked on the sides or top. This requires more than just tapping; you must use a sharp eye and a strategic mind to plan your moves carefully. By peeling back layers systematically and avoiding dead ends, your objective is to clear every single tile from the board to solve the logic puzzle and master the challenge.
⭐ Why You’ll Love Mahjong Master:
- 🧩 Pure Puzzle Satisfaction – Experience the thrill of "cracking the code." Each layout is a logic puzzle that requires you to find the right order of matching to win.
- 🧠 Serious Brain Training – Designed to keep your mind active and agile. Perfect for seniors looking to prevent memory loss or anyone wanting to test their IQ.
- 🀄 Classic & Authentic – No distractions. Just you and the traditional Mahjong tiles. We focus on the essence of the classic board game experience.
- 👀 Sharp & Clear Visuals – We use Extra Large Tiles with high-contrast symbols. The interface is clean and crisp, ensuring you never miss a match due to poor visibility.
- 🏆 Progressive Difficulty – Starts easy to help you learn the logic, then ramps up to complex, multi-layered structures that will truly test your patience and skill.
- 💡 Strategic Tools – Stuck on a tough layer? Use Hints to find hidden pairs or Undo to correct a mistake. Use tools to learn, not just to win.
- 📶 Play Offline – Train your brain anywhere, anytime. No Wi-Fi required.
Mahjong Master: Daily Match isn't just a game; it's a test of your cognitive skills. If you enjoy the satisfaction of solving problems and keeping your brain sharp, this is the game for you.

name: Kingshot
summary: The Ultimate Medieval Strategy Idle Game!
description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

name: Pixel Flow!
summary: Pig's Pops!
description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

name: Salvage Empire
summary: Tow wrecks, pull parts, build your yard, and crush every rival in the desert.
description:
Free to download and play, with optional in-game purchases, including random items.

From one rusty tow truck to the biggest salvage yard in the desert.

Nobody out here hands you anything. You roll into town with a tow truck, a toolbox, and the deed to a dirt lot full of dead cars, while every rival crew already owns a yard. This is a game about building a salvage business from scratch: tow the wrecks, pull the parts, rebuild what's worth saving, and sell everything from a single tire to a running ride. Put the profits back in until that lot is the yard everyone for a hundred miles knows by name.

TOW THE WRECKS

Day one: one tow truck, one wrench, and a yard full of rust. Haul in totaled sedans, dead pickups, and crashed muscle cars, and when a rare one goes up for auction, make sure it comes home with you. Every wreck is worth something to somebody.

PULL, SORT, SELL

Pull the engines, tires, gears, and chrome. Sort the parts into piles across the lot, crush the leftovers into scrap, and sell everything from a single spark plug to a fully rebuilt engine. Each sale pays for a bigger yard, a stronger crane, and one more bay in the garage.

BUILD YOUR YARD

Upgrade a tin shed into a working garage. Open an engine shop, a tire shop, and a gear workshop, then unlock bigger lots, stronger cranes, and better tools. The bigger the yard, the more wrecks it can take in, and the more parts and rides roll out the other end.

EXPAND YOUR FLEET

Not every wreck gets sold for parts. Rebuild the toughest frames into running rides, from rat rods and pickups to station wagons and dune buggies, and put them to work. Send the fleet out to haul in wrecks from across the desert, run parts to buyers in the next town over, and back up your crew when a rival shows up at the gate. The bigger the fleet, the harder you are to push around.

RECRUIT YOUR CREW

Hire mechanics, drivers, welders, and the odd fast-talking auctioneer, each with their own skills, attitude, and story. Train them, promote the best, and send them to run the shops, lead the fleet, and stand their ground when a rival crew comes calling. A crew is only as tough as the boss who runs it.

CRUSH THE COMPETITION

Rival crews want what you've built, and sooner or later they come rolling up to your gate. Hold your ground, crew against crew, then beat them where it counts: outbid them at auction, out-haul them on the road, and out-build them at home until their yards run dry. Take over their yards, hang your sign on the gate, and send them packing. Team up with allied crews to hold what's yours, and win the map one yard at a time. Keep winning, and every ride in the desert runs on your parts.

Build the crew. Crush the competition. Own the desert. Your tow truck is parked at the gate, keys in the ignition. Download now and go haul in your first wreck.

♣  FAIRNESS: Cards are dealt randomly using a random number generator (RNG) that is widely recognized and used by many applications. This ensures a fair gaming experience, where your skill at the game makes all the difference.
♣  CHOOSE FROM THREE DIFFERENT CARD DESIGNS: German, French or Tournament card deck
♣  PLAY WITH TOURNAMENT- OR CASUAL RULES: both variants have their charms - just try them out
♣  FLAUNT YOUR SKILLS IN THE LEAGUE: rise up the ranks in our leagues and become a champion
♣  SUPPORT: our intuitive and easy to navigate app, various help sites and a great customer support will facilitate your journey to becoming a Skat master!

If you are a fan of other card games like Doppelkopf, Rummy or Solitaire then you will love Skat! Our game is and will remain entirely free to play, you may however benefit from in-app purchases to enhance your gameplay experience!

Let’s go - Download our app today and enjoy a thrilling new card game experience!
Your Skat Treff Team

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

description:

Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

name: Strava: Run, Bike, Walk
summary: Track your active life in one place and share the journey with friends.
description:
Join over 180 million active people on Strava – the free app where building community meets fitness tracking. 

Whether you're a world-class athlete or just starting out, Strava has your back the entire journey. Here's how: 

Track your growth 

• Record It All: Running, cycling, walking, hiking, yoga. You can record all those activities – plus over 40 other sport types. If it's not on Strava, it didn’t happen. 

•  See the full story of your strength training  Lifting in the gym weekly, doing HIIT workouts? Use your favorite device or strength app and your exercises, sets, reps, weights and a muscle map show up automatically.  

• Connect Your Favorite Apps and Devices: Sync with thousands of devices like Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit and Peloton – you name it. The Strava Wear OS app includes a tile and a complication you can use to quickly launch activities.
• Understand Your Progress: Get data insights to see how you're improving over time. 
• Compete on Segments: Show off your competitive streak. Race against others on segments to the top of the leaderboards. 

Find and connect with your crew 

• Build a Support Network: Take the Strava community offline and meet in real life. 
• Join and Create Challenges: Participate in monthly challenges to chase new goals, collect digital badges and stay motivated while encouraging others. 
• Stay Connected: Your Strava feed is filled with real efforts from real people. Follow friends or your favorite athletes and send kudos to celebrate every win. 

Move with confidence 

• Move Safer with Beacon: Share your real-time location with loved ones for an extra layer of safety during your activities. 
• Control your privacy: Adjust who can see your activities and personal data. 
• Edit Map Visibility: Hide the beginning or end points of your activities. 

Get even more with a Strava subscription
•  Discover Routes Anywhere: Get intelligent route recommendations with popular routes based on your preferences and location, or create your own bike routes and footpaths using our Routes tool. 
• Live Segments: Receive real-time updates on your performance during popular segments. 
• Training Log & Best Efforts: Dive deeper into your data to understand your progress and set new personal records. 
• Group Challenges: Create challenges with friends to stay motivated together. 
• Athlete Intelligence (AI): Access AI-driven insights that makes your workout data easy to understand. No confusion. No guesswork. 
• Access Recover Athletics: Prevent injury with custom exercises tailored to your activities.
•  Goals: Set custom goals for distance, time or segments, and stay motivated as you work towards them. 
• Deals: Enjoy special offers and discounts from our partner brands.
• Training Log: Dive deeper into your data with detailed training logs and track your progress over time. 

Whether you’re aiming for a personal best or just getting started, you belong here. Just record and go. 

Strava includes both a free version and a subscription version with premium features. 

Terms of Service: https://www.strava.com/legal/terms Privacy Policy: https://www.strava.com/legal/privacy NOTE ON GPS SUPPORT: Strava depends on GPS for recording activities. In some devices, the GPS does not work properly and Strava will not record effectively. If your Strava recordings show poor location estimation behavior, please try to update the operating system to the most recent version. There are some devices which have consistently poor performance with no known remedies. On these devices, we restrict installation of Strava, for example the Samsung Galaxy Ace 3 and the Galaxy Express 2. See our support site for more information: https://support.strava.com/hc/en-us/articles/216919047-Supported-Android-devices-and-Android-operating-systems

name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
summary: Millions of crafters have smashed billions of blocks! Now you can join the fun!
description:
Dive into an open world of block building, crafting, and survival in the ultimate sandbox adventure. Gather resources, survive the night, and build a world one block at a time in this online survival game. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!

Craft a new house, build cities, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, block building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior block building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in your world. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated online world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!

In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!

BUILD YOUR DREAM WORLD

• Build a house or create an entire world from the ground up
• Block building games for kids, adults, or anyone
• Craft and build your world from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes
• Use survival strategies to explore an endless open world simulation full of different biomes and creatures
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace
• Private and community servers – Online games allow you to connect with millions of players, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server online game
• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more within your online world
• Add-ons – Block builders can customize their experience even further with add-ons as they build up! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs online


MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES
• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of other builders
• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Explore endless realms where your survival strategies are put to the test. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you
• Customize your world with Realms Plus. Get instant access to an extensive catalogue that is refreshed every month! Share with friends on your own private Realms server*
• MMO servers allow you to connect and play with players across the world, to explore custom worlds, build with friends, and participate in large-scale events
• Enjoy crafting buildings, building gigantic community-run worlds, competing in unique mini-games, and socializing in lobbies full of fellow Minecraft block builders

SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help
LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/

MINIMUM RECOMMENDED SPECIFICATION
To check the requirements for your device visit: https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409172223501

*Realms & Realms Plus: Try a free 30-day trial in-app.

This app uses Accessibility services.
Minecraft includes an Accessibility Service that improves touch interaction when using a screen reader. This service only adjusts touch-passthrough regions — it does not read, log, or transmit your screen content or personal data.

name: Warhammer Survivors
summary: Warhammer Survivors is a roguelite survivors games. Fend off endless swarms!
description:
The addictive bullet heaven action of the survivors genre comes to the 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms in an officially licensed game from Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors). 

Experience Warhammers’ epic champions, enemies, weapons and more, meticulously handcrafted in animated pixel glory  - optimized for mobile!

FEATURES  

- Frenetic Bullet Heaven survival in a grim dark setting 
- Over 40 iconic playable characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, featuring Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s very own Malum Caedo! 
- Multiple modes and stages from across the grim, dark 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms.  
- An arsenal of 75+ weapons, such as the Boltgun, Astartes Chainsword, Whirlwind Axes and easter eggs such as the humble pot of Nuln Oil.  
- Face down the mightiest monsters the universes have to offer, including the disgustingly bloated, Great Unclean One. Extremis Bosses pose a challenge even for Survivors-like veterans! 
- A mighty cache of passives and power-ups to aid in enduring against the monstrous legions.  
- Esoteric secrets to uncover and collectables to collect! 
- Mobile-optimized controls and gameplay systems
- Premium experience with no ads or energy mechanics
- ...and more!

name: Booster Pack Heroes
summary: An incremental game about opening booster packs and surviving monster hordes.
description:
*Buy the game now to get a special 30% launch discount ($6.99 instead of $9.99)!*

Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

OPEN PACKS
Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

UPGRADE YOUR POWER
Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

SURVIVE THE HORDE
Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS
Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.
…and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.

The cycle has repeated countless times.
You're here to break it.

name: Geometry Dash
summary: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rythm-based action platformer!
description:
Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

Prepare for a near impossible challenge in the world of Geometry Dash. Push your skills to the limit as you jump, fly and flip your way through dangerous passages and spiky obstacles.

Simple one touch game play with lots of levels that will keep you entertained for hours!

Game Features

• Rhythm-based Action Platforming!
• Lots of levels with unique soundtracks!
• Build and share your own levels using the level editor!
• Unlock new icons and colors to customize your character!
• Fly rockets, flip gravity and much more!
• Use practice mode to sharpen your skills!
• Lots of achievements and rewards!
• No in-app purchases!
• Challenge yourself with the near impossible!

Contact: support@robtopgames.com

name: Munchkin
summary: Kill the monsters & grab the loot in the classic card game!
description:
Kill the monsters! Steal the treasure! Stab your buddy!
In partnership with Steve Jackson Games, the iconic tabletop card game Munchkin brings its murderous mischief to digital devices!
Go down to the dungeon. Kick in the door. Kill everything you find. Backstab your friends. Steal the treasure and run.
With millions of copies sold around the world, Munchkin is the mega-hit card game about dungeon adventure...with none of that stupid roleplaying stuff. You and your friends compete to kill monsters and grab magic items. Don the Horny Helmet and the Boots of Butt-Kicking. Wield the Staff of Napalm...or maybe the Chainsaw of Bloody Dismemberment. Start by slaughtering the Potted Plant and the Drooling Slime, and work your way up to the Plutonium Dragon!
Shuffle Up an Adventure!
You're a Munchkin...and Munchkins love treasure! But a stack of pesky monster and Curse cards are between you and your hard-earned loot!
Munchkin is played in a series of rounds using Door cards and Treasure cards to explore a dungeon.
Build a character by combining Race and Class cards, then gear up to face the lurking monsters!
Kill monsters and collect Treasure to level up! The first Munchkin to reach Level 10 wins!
But wait...there's more!
Cross-platform, online multiplayer shenanigans!
Learn the tricks of the adventuring trade in a dungeon-delving tutorial!
Sharpen your blade in Solo Challenges with special rules!
Go looking for trouble in Munchkin. Hey, we're all going to get roasted and eaten sometime.

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Children of Morta
summary: A story-driven roguelite RPG
description:
*Save up to 80%!*

Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG with a roguelite approach to character development, in which you don’t play a single character but a whole, extraordinary family of heroes. 

Hack’n’slash through hordes of enemies in procedurally generated dungeons, caves and lands and lead the Bergson family, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. The story takes place in a distant land but copes with themes and emotions common to all of us: love and hope, longing and uncertainty, ultimately loss... and sacrifice we are willing to make to save the ones we care the most for. 
Ultimately, it's about a family of heroes standing together against the encroaching darkness.

-- Complete Edition --

Both the Ancient Spirits and the Paws and Claws DLC are included in the main game and available as you play.

FEATURES
- Welcome to the family! Join the heroic Bergsons in their trials to honor their heritage and save the land of Rea from the creeping Corruption 
- One for all, all for one: improve skills and gear for the whole family through each run in the ever-changing world of this roguelite RPG
- Stronger together: switch between 7 playable characters, each with their own abilities, fighting styles and endearing personality 
- Immerse yourself in the beautiful, deadly world of Rea through gorgeous 2D pixel art mixing handcrafted animations with modern lighting techniques
- Family that slays together stays together: use the two-player online coop mode and rely on each other in every fight (available in a post-launch update)

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
- Compatible with controllers

name: Bloons TD 6
summary: Smash Hit Tower Defense Game
description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Over a decade of tower defense pedigree and regular massive updates makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite game for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming with Bloons TD 6!

HUGE CONTENT!
* Regular updates! We release several updates every year with new characters, features, and gameplay.
* Boss Events! Fearsome Boss Bloons will challenge even the strongest defenses.
* Odysseys! Battle through a series of maps connected by their theme, rules, and rewards.
* Contested Territory! Join forces with other players and battle for territory against five other teams. Capture tiles on a shared map and compete on the leaderboards.
* Quests! Delve into what makes the Monkeys tick with Quests, crafted to tell tales and share knowledge.
* Trophy Store! Earn Trophies to unlock dozens of cosmetic items that let you customize your Monkeys, Bloons, animations, music, and more.
* Content Browser! Create your own Challenges and Odysseys, then share them with other players and check out the most liked and played community content.

EPIC MONKEY TOWERS & HEROES!
* 25 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the newest Paragon upgrades.
* 17 diverse Heroes, with 20 signature upgrades and 2 special abilities. Plus, unlockable skins and voiceovers!

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

We truly respect your time and support, and we hope Bloons TD 6 will be the best strategy game you’ve ever played. If it’s not, please contact us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com and tell us what we can do better!

Now those Bloons aren't going to pop themselves... sharpen your darts and go play Bloons TD 6!


**********
Ninja Kiwi Notes: 

Please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You will be prompted in-game to accept these terms in order to cloud save and protect your game progress:
https://ninjakiwi.com/terms
https://ninjakiwi.com/privacy_policy

Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases. 

Ninja Kiwi Community:
We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative, at https://support.ninjakiwi.com.

Streamers and Video Creators: 
Ninja Kiwi is actively promoting channel creators on YouTube and Twitch! If you are not already working with us, keep making videos and tell us about your channel at streamers@ninjakiwi.com.

name: Stardew Valley
summary: The smash hit farming RPG now on mobile!
description:
Stardew Valley comes to Mobile!

Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.

**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**
**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**

---

BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:

■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm

■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way

■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from

■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates

■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests

■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure

■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside

■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal

■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on Android with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines

■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...

■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen, virtual joystick, and external controller support.

---

"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN

“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb

“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine

---

Note: Features 1.4 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.

name: Poppy Playtime Chapter 5
summary: Face The Prototype in the darkest Poppy Playtime chapter yet.
description:
Face the puppetmaster behind the horrors of Playtime Co. in the latest chapter of the official Poppy Playtime adventure. Descend deeper than ever before, survive Huggy Wuggy's relentless pursuit, and uncover secrets years in the making.

---Enter The Prototype's Domain---
Your journey has brought you into the darkest depths of the factory. Abandoned by your allies, you must venture alone into a realm ruled by The Prototype, where every shadow hides another piece of Playtime Co.'s horrifying past.

---Survive What Lurks Below---
Huggy Wuggy is hunting you once again but he isn't the only thing waiting in the darkness. Encounter the tortured inhabitants of The Prototype's domain. Some may help you survive. Others may have very different plans.

---New Tools. Deadlier Challenges.---
Your GrabPack gains new tools and functionality as the dangers of Playtime Co. grow more deadly.
- Master new GrabPack tools and abilities.
- Solve devious new environmental puzzles.
- Overcome deadly obstacles deep within the factory.
- Encounter new characters whose motives may not be what they seem.
- Uncover some of Playtime Co.'s darkest secrets yet.

You've spent four chapters searching for answers.
Now you're approaching the rotten heart of Playtime Co.
Can you survive The Prototype's domain?

name: Dune: Imperium Digital
summary: The award-winning board game of strategy and intrigue. The Spice must flow.
description:
Immerse yourself in the world of Dune.

Experience the ultimate blend of strategy and intrigue as you navigate the treacherous landscapes of Arrakis in the award-winning board game Dune: Imperium!

Battle online, locally with AI, or against the formidable House Hagal.
Earn Achievements that showcase your prowess as a leader.

Embark on more than a dozen Challenges that will test your wit and cunning.
Compete for badges in the rotating Skirmish Mode where no two games are the same!

Control the Spice. Control the Universe.

Arrakis. Dune. Desert Planet. Raise your banner above the vast wasteland before you. As the Great Houses of the Landsraad marshal their forces and their spies, whom will you influence, and whom will you betray? A tyrannical Emperor. The secretive Bene Gesserit. The shrewd Spacing Guild. The ferocious Fremen of the Deep Desert. The power of the Imperium can be yours, but war is not the only way to claim it.

Dune: Imperium blends deck-building and worker placement in a deeply thematic new strategy game where the fate of the Empire hangs on your decisions. Will you seek political allies or rely upon military might? Economic strength or subtle intrigues? A council seat… or a sharpened blade? The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. The Imperium awaits.

name: Mini Metro
summary: Design a subway map for a growing city.
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on Android. No ads or in-app purchases.

• 2016 BAFTA nominee
• 2016 IGF award winner
• 2016 IGN Mobile Game of the Year finalist
• 2016 Gamespot's Best Mobile Game selection

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colorblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

Please note that Mini Metro is incompatible with some Bluetooth headphones. If you do not hear audio over Bluetooth, please try disconnecting your headphones and restarting the game.

name: MONOPOLY
summary: Roll the dice, pass go and win! Play Hasbro's official MONOPOLY mobile game.
description:
Play MONOPOLY on the go without distractions – no ads, no fuss! 

Challenge friends, family and fans from around the globe in the digital version of the official MONOPOLY board game, licensed by Hasbro. 

Head online to play your favourite board game with anyone, anywhere, at any time, or compete against state-of-the-art AI opponents offline. Plus, with the seamless PASS & PLAY mode, you can play the classic MONOPOLY board game with your friends with just one device! 

The classic MONOPOLY board game takes a bold leap into a new format, arriving on mobile with amazing graphics, smooth animations and a catchy soundtrack! 


HOW TO PLAY MONOPOLY

1. Download the official MONOPOLY app
2. Press “PLAY”
3. Pick a mode, board, dice and token
4. Roll the dice and move around the board
5. If you land on a property tile, you can buy it
6. Collect rent when other players land on it
7. Continue around the board, drawing cards when instructed – will you be hit with a surprise tax? Sent to jail? Or get a little bonus money? 
8. If you run out of money, you’ll be bankrupt and out of the game
9. The last player left with a profit wins! 

FEATURES

- MONOPOLY ON THE GO – No connection? No problem. Our roster of AI opponents are ready to challenge you! Or play with your friends offline with Pass & Play! 
- MULTIPLE MODES – Take on AI opponents in Single Player or compete against friends and family in Pass & Play or Online With Friends. Try out Online Multiplayer and face off against fellow tycoons from around the world! 
- EXCLUSIVE BOARDS – Experience the iconic board game like never before with exclusive boards and more! 
- AWESOME NEW TOKENS AND DICE – Whatever your style, MONOPOLY has a set of dice fit for a future tycoon! Pick from nostalgic classic tokens or brand-new designs exclusive to the mobile game.

Get the most authentic MONOPOLY experience with the official MONOPOLY mobile game!

The MONOPOLY name and logo, the distinctive design of the gameboard, the four corner squares, the MR. MONOPOLY name and character, as well as each of the distinctive elements of the board and playing pieces are trademarks of Hasbro for its property trading game and game equipment. © 1935, 2025 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved.

name: Farming Simulator 26 Mobile
summary: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!
description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

name: Slay the Spire
summary: Deckbuilding Dungeon Crawl
description:
We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

Features
- Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at climbing the Spire. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top.
- An Ever-changing Spire: Whenever you embark on a journey up the Spire, the layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different relics, and even fight different bosses!
- Powerful Relics to Discover: Powerful items known as relics can be found throughout the Spire. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a relic may cost you more than just gold.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
summary: Fly around the world! Pilot 3D airplanes and land at airports in this live sim!
description:
EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE FLIGHT SIMULATOR ON YOUR MOBILE DEVICE!
Take your passion for aviation to new heights with RFS - Real Flight Simulator!
Fly realistic aircraft, explore the world from the cockpit, and discover more immersive scenery with 3D Buildings and Ultra-HD Satellite Imagery in selected locations.
From your first takeoff to long-haul flights, experience what it means to be a real pilot.

FLY NOW, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD!
Take off, land, and complete full flights across a global flight simulation environment. Explore aircraft with 3D live cockpits, navigate detailed airports, create flight plans, and sharpen your skills with pilot tutorials. Discover familiar city skylines and landscapes brought to life with new levels of detail.

UNLOCK THE FULL REAL FLIGHT SIMULATOR EXPERIENCE
Choose the subscription that fits you: monthly, six-month, or yearly. Join a worldwide community of virtual aviators and access premium flight simulation features.

BUCKLE UP AND BECOME A REAL PILOT!
Experience the features of a PRO pilot in our realistic airplane simulator:
• 65+ AIRPLANE MODELS: Pilot a growing fleet of aircraft with realistic 3D live cockpits, authentic lighting, instruments, and flight systems.
• 2400+ HD AIRPORTS: Take off and land at detailed airports with 3D terminals, vehicles, and realistic ground procedures.
• 3D BUILDINGS: Discover selected cities reconstructed around real-world building positions, with recognizable urban layouts, shapes, and colors. Fly above streets and neighborhoods that feel closer to the real world. Explore an expanding world of detailed 3D cities, with new areas coming in future updates.
• GLOBAL SATELLITE SCENERY: Explore high-definition satellite terrain and elevation maps worldwide, bringing global landscapes to life.
• ULTRA-HD SATELLITE IMAGERY: See terrain, roads, and landscapes with remarkable clarity in supported regions, adding a new level of detail from cruising altitude to final approach. Discover new Ultra-HD areas as coverage continues to expand.
• REAL-TIME FLIGHTS & WEATHER: Join 40,000+ real-time flights daily with live air traffic and experience real-time weather conditions as you fly.
• DETAILED CHECKLISTS: Follow authentic pilot procedures, from preflight preparation to landing.
• ADVANCED GROUND SYSTEMS: Interact with refueling trucks, passenger vehicles, and follow-me cars.
• ADVANCED FLIGHT PLANNING: Customize weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots.
• AUTOPILOT & ASSISTED LANDING: Use precise autopilot controls and the Automatic Landing System for long-haul flights.

ENGAGE IN GLOBAL MULTIPLAYER MODES
• Fly with hundreds of other pilots around the world in real-time multiplayer.
• Chat with pilots, join weekly events, and take part in Virtual Airlines (VA) to earn Flight Points.

ATC MODE: BECOME AN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER
• ATC GAME MODE: Manage air traffic, issue instructions, and guide aircraft safely.
• Experience interactive, multi-voice ATC procedures and communications from both sides of the radio.

CREATE AND SHARE YOUR AVIATION PASSION
• CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLANE: Design unique liveries and share them with the RFS community.
• DESIGN YOUR AIRPORT: Build your favorite HD airport and see other pilots use your creation.
• PLANE SPOTTING: Capture aircraft against city lights, dramatic clouds, and spectacular sunrises and sunsets.
• Discover new flight routes and connect with aviation enthusiasts worldwide.

REAL-TIME SIMULATION REQUIREMENTS
An internet connection is required for full simulation and multiplayer features.

GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!
Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!

TERMS OF USE: https://www.rortos.com/terms-of-use/
Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
summary: Epic fantasy tower defense, return to Linirea and rewrite the kingdom's past
description:
Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis, the latest chapter in the legendary tower defense saga. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, command epic heroes, and stop a young Vez'nan before the kingdom falls, on a battlefield where every tower placement matters.

Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of goblins, orcs, and worse across the original Kingdom Rush lands. Offline. Pure tower defense.
History is broken. The Kingdom has fallen. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past.

A PREQUEL WITH STAKES
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and uncover the moment that turned a young mage into the saga's greatest villain.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them.  Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break. Classic tower defense, refined.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: Brotato: Premium
summary: 🥔 Survive the alien horde! Equip 6 weapons at once in this roguelite shooter.
description:
Blast through alien hordes as Brotato, the only potato capable of wielding 6 weapons simultaneously! 

You are the last hope on a hostile planet. Stranded and outnumbered, you must battle relentless waves of aliens, scavenge materials, and craft unique builds to survive until rescue arrives. Can you hold out against the endless swarm?

Each run lasts just 20–30 minutes, delivering thrilling, fast-paced roguelite action perfect for quick mobile sessions. Build your strategy with dozens of traits and hundreds of items—and see how far you can survive!

【KEY FEATURES】
⚔️ SIX-WEAPON FRENZY: Wield up to 6 weapons at once with default auto-firing or precision manual aiming.
⏱️ FAST-PACED ACTION: Quick, intense runs designed to be completed in under 30 minutes.
🎭 DIVERSE CHARACTERS: Choose from a wide range of traits—from One-Armed and Crazy to Lucky and Mage—to create your unique build.
🛠️ INFINITE BUILDS: Experiment with hundreds of items and weapons, including flamethrowers, SMGs, rocket launchers, and even sticks & stones!
🌊 SURVIVAL WAVES: Survive 20 to 90-second waves and collect materials to level up and gear up in the shop.

⚠️ NOTE: Cloud saving is available only while online. You can play offline, but your progress will not be synced to the cloud without an internet connection.

【STAY CONNECTED】
📺 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtaSitbjWjhnlzuX2ZLjtUg
💬 Discord: @Erabit or join via https://discord.gg/P6vekfhc46
🐦 Twitter: @erabit_studios
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@brotato_mobile
📘 Facebook: @Brotato (facebook.com/brotatomobile)
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brotato_mobile/
